worldcombat.skill.icefang.summary: Hold on and let the cold seep into the joints: the bite deals damage, then a beat later the cold settles in and may freeze the target; against an already frozen body the brittle ice cracks for extra damage, and the bite may also flinch the target and cut off what it is doing. Deep-freeze style freezes longer; quick-freeze style bites harder.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.use.0: Bite and try to freeze a target at close range
worldcombat.skill.icefang.use.2: Wince the target and cut off what it is doing
worldcombat.skill.icefang.description.0: The user lunges at the target and bites what its fangs sweep: about %1$s contact and bite damage over a %2$s-block radius; the target's defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.description.1: A beat after the bite (%3$s) the cold settles in: a %1$s chance to freeze the target for %2$s; while frozen it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks and cannot move, Ice types are immune, and Fire damage thaws it.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.description.2: If the target was already frozen when bitten, the brittle ice cracks for about %1$s extra damage.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.description.3: A hit has a %1$s chance to wince the target for %2$s: it interrupts an interruptible action in progress and prevents new moves or ordinary attacks during that time (it can still move).
worldcombat.skill.icefang.deep.on: Deep-freeze style: easier and longer freezes and a heavier crack, but a lighter bite and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.deep.off: Quick-freeze style: a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but a shorter freeze and a lighter crack.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and the freeze duration to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.icefang.preference.dee: On: freeze chance +12%%, freeze duration x1.4, crack damage x1.3, but bite power x0.90, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks, for locking down and cracking a key target. Off (quick freeze): a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but a shorter freeze and a lighter crack.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The ice fang reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: already frozen targets rank first, since this bite cracks the ice for extra damage, and a frozen, wounded target ranks higher still; off: order by ordinary melee only.
